note: Machine-readable mirror of the operator-set hard budget cap for model-in-the-loop scorecard runs (the model under test only; see the epic's operator directives, which are authoritative). worstCasePerRun.note: Per-run worst-case reservation for the deepseek lane (prompt tokens are cumulative across a run's tool rounds; sized for a deep multi-round research run — the scripted lane's full arc set measured ~100k prompt tokens across ALL its runs, so 250k for ONE run is a wide margin).
